name: jaq
description: Lightning-fast Rust jq clone with 30x faster startup and superior performance - focused on correctness, speed, and simplicity with security auditing

jaq.description: Ultra-fast Rust jq implementation with 30x faster startup and superior performance on most benchmarks - security audited with 500+ test suite
jaq.usage:
jaq '.users[] | select(.active)' users.json
jaq -r '.items[] | "\(.name): \(.price)"' catalog.json
echo '{"data": [1,2,3]}' | jaq '.data | map(. * 2)'
jaq '.logs[] | select(.level == "error") | .message' app.log
jaq --version # Check version and performance info
